name: 🍟Work at BurgerBlox Fast Food
desc:
🍟Welcome to BurgerBlox Fast Food, where you can choose to be a customer and order some delicious menu items at the restaurant, or you can become a team member and work hard to serve customers! 

💝 Follow the owner: https://www.roblox.com/users/680656472/profile
🔗 Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/8927586/!/ 

📌 Click the "Staff Apps" button on the top right side in game to claim your rank, attend a training or attend a quiz. 

👕 Merch is under the group store!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/8927586/r#!/store
